Container.Name: 3d-space-pong
Container.Overview:
3D Space Pong
A browser-based 3D Pong game with persistent match tracking and a dry comedic voice. 1P vs five AI difficulty levels (Rookie through Legend) or 2P local on one keyboard. Every AI match is recorded -- wins AND losses -- to a combined Hall of Fame / Hall of Shame leaderboard. Installable as a PWA; local play keeps working offline.
Single container, single bind mount, SQLite database. Back up by copying one file (/app/data/pong.db).
The default WebUI port below is 3610 on the host -- the container listens internally on 3000, so 3610 avoids colliding with other self-hosted apps (many of which default to 3000). Remap it to whatever you like.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Host port mapped to the container's internal HTTP port (3000). 3610 is the non-colliding default used in production; remap freely.

Config.Name: App Data
Config.Description: Persistent SQLite database (pong.db plus its WAL sidecars). Back up by copying this folder.

Config.Name: PORT
Config.Description: Port the Node process listens on *inside* the container. Change the WebUI Port mapping above instead of this unless you specifically need to change the internal port too.

Config.Name: DB_DRIVER
Config.Description: Database driver. Only sqlite is currently implemented.

Config.Name: DB_URL
Config.Description: SQLite file path inside the container. Leave as-is unless you changed the App Data mount target.
